display_name: KYE Open Access Authority™ — access-admissibility product spec
description: Illustrative instance of the KYE Open Access Authority™ manifest: the five access verbs, resource classes, the admissibility decision flow, and the Resource Authority Badge™ states. Every verdict is a Purpose-Permission admissibility decision scoped to an access action — not a separate decision engine.

boundary.oaa: The agent-to-resource access projection of the admissibility decision.
boundary.non_competition: KYE governs whether an agent may access a resource; it does not run the agent or route its traffic.

decision_flow.binding: Resolve the requesting agent to exactly one principal in one tenant.
What delegation does the principal hold over this resource class?
Which jurisdiction governs the principal-and-resource pair; cross-border handoff.
Admissibility verdict: allow / deny / allow-with-notice / consent / minimisation.
Evidence Pack plus attestation; Replay-Proof from public keys alone.

transitions.on: access decisions emit Evidence Packs and are replay-verifiable
